analysis_games_scope: All NFL Week 9 regular-season games scheduled Sunday, November 8, 2026; exclude Thursday November 5 and Monday November 9.

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed qualifying regular-season games before the historical cutoff.

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 8

current_sportsbook_source.fallback: DraftKings only where FanDuel data is unavailable

model_version: V7.2.8 with explicit user-directed P7 methodology override
user_methodology_overrides: Use the 7th percentile (P7), calculated from the 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the Week 9 historical cutoff, instead of P25.
Include P7 as an explicit reference in the Stage 1 ladder output alongside the fixed ladder hit rates.

For Stage 2 output ordering, group players by position; within each position, candidates whose P7 is above the current main-market line appear first; then order by absolute proximity of P7 to the main-market line.
P7 is unavailable when fewer than 20 qualifying historical games exist; do not substitute P25.

percentile_definition.sample_basis: 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the Week 9 historical cutoff
percentile_definition.independence: P7 is calculated independently of the locked L10 sample.
